verdict.rationale: Pipecat documents swapping speech services across many integrated providers, usually in one line of code. It also documents STT final-transcript latency tuning with per-service P99 values, and community reports confirm local Whisper STT support, so control over the STT provider is directly evidenced. Transcription accuracy and finer-grained controls such as key-term boosting or STT model/language selection are not documented. Missing for 10: evidence of transcription accuracy, key-term/vocabulary boosting, explicit STT model or language configuration, and independent hands-on corroboration of real-time transcription quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get accurate real-time transcription with control over the STT provider, language models, or key terms

citations.quote: Swap speech, language, and vision services from any of 200+ integrated providers and services — usually one line of code.
Time To Final Segment (TTFS) measures how long it takes from the moment a user stops speaking until the STT service delivers the final transcript.
Pipecat ships with measured P99 latency values for each supported service so that turn detection can account for this delay automatically.
Local STT is also supported via whisper, which pipecat will download and manage for you.
